exposure: Human umbilical cord mesenchymal stem cell (HUCMSC) transplantation
Bone marrow mesenchymal stem cell (BMSC) transplantation
cohort: The study utilized an acute radiation disease mouse model, establishing hematopoietic stem cell transplantation (HSCT) mouse models.
finding: HUCMSC transplantation significantly improved the survival rate and functional recovery from radiation-induced hematopoiesis failure and reduced inflammatory reaction, demonstrating advantages over BMSC transplantation.
